“KNN secretly behaves like metric learning once you stop being lazy with distances.”
KNN is famous for being simple.
But SmartKNN flips that assumption.
Instead of treating KNN as a static, distance-based dinosaur, SmartKNN treats it as a geometry problem:
Before searching neighbors… what if we reshape the entire feature space itself?

Most models learn parameters.
Each feature weight defines how much that axis matters in the distance function:
distance = sqrt( Σ weight[i] * (x[i] - y[i])² )

articles.description:
Taking on a new challenge: solving GeeksforGeeks POTD daily and sharing my solutions! 💻🔥
Problem:

https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/problems/transpose-of-matrix-1587115621/1
Transpose of Matrix
Difficulty: Easy    Accuracy: 66.5%
You are given a square matrix of size n x n. Your task is to find the transpose of the given matrix.
Examples :
Solution:
class Solution:
    def transpose(self, mat):
        n = len(mat)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i+1, n):
                mat[i][j], mat[j][i] = mat[j][i], mat[i][j]
        return mat

# Build image

  --name n8n \
  -p 5678:5678 \
  -v ~/.n8n:/home/node/.n8n \
  n8nio/n8n

Here, --name sets the container name, -p maps the port, and -v ensures your workflows are saved persistently."
